subject: science
skillName: Building Shade to Block the Sun's Warmth

items.prompt:
A shade structure
A) blocks sunlight from an area
B) makes more sunlight
C) warms the area
D) does nothing
items.answer: A) blocks sunlight from an area

steps: A shade blocks sunlight so the area stays cooler.

items.prompt:
A shaded area is usually
A) cooler than a sunny one
B) warmer than a sunny one
C) the same
D) brighter
items.answer: A) cooler than a sunny one

steps: Shade keeps sunlight out, so it stays cooler.

items.prompt:
An umbrella keeps you cooler by
A) blocking the sunlight
B) making light
C) adding heat
D) making wind

steps: The umbrella makes shade by blocking sunlight.

items.prompt:
Which material could you use to build a shade?
A) Clear glass
B) Cardboard
C) A mirror pointing up
D) Water

steps: Cardboard blocks sunlight to make shade.

items.prompt:
You can tell your shade worked if the shaded spot is
A) warmer
B) cooler than a sunny spot
C) brighter
D) the same
items.answer: B) cooler than a sunny spot

steps: A cooler shaded spot shows the shade worked.

items.prompt:
A spot under a tree stays cooler because the tree
A) makes sunlight
B) blocks the sunlight
C) adds heat
D) does nothing

steps: Tree leaves make shade that blocks sunlight.

items.prompt:
A torn paper shade lets sunlight through. To make it work better, you should
A) tear it more
B) use a stronger material that blocks sunlight
C) use clear plastic
D) remove it
items.answer: B) use a stronger material that blocks sunlight

steps: A stronger material blocks more sunlight.

items.prompt:
The goal of a shade structure is to
A) make an area warmer
B) reduce how much sunlight warms an area
C) make more light
D) block the wind only
items.answer: B) reduce how much sunlight warms an area

steps: A shade reduces the Sun's warming of the area.
